policy: Intended means the exact requested source identity. Similar container content does not substitute for an explicitly requested Idea or Document. No-match requires no eligible source that fulfills the stated constraints; contradictory, inaccessible and withdrawn sources cannot satisfy the query. No source text or query was edited.

ambiguity.resolution: The harbor keeper uses three short lantern flashes to signal a closed eastern channel. This uniquely identifies Idea 001. The query adds amber, a color not recorded in the source; treat it as a noisy descriptive cue, not a grounded source fact.
The violin maker explicitly selects hide glue because the joint must remain reversible. This is the instrument restoration and undoable bond requested.
The rooftop basil uses collected rain in blue barrels during a hose restriction. This meets the elevated herb garden and restricted water-supply relationship.
The bicycle courier shelters a birthday parcel beneath a railway arch during hail. The transport, gift, shelter, and weather jointly identify this Idea.
The archivist lifts waterlogged glass negatives with mesh and forbids rubbing their emulsion. The matching content is at the end of a long source, not in its repeated working-log prefix.

The drummer follows red floor lights into the pit without a spoken cue. Only Project 06 is permitted for this Document-entry query; every other Project and its sources are forbidden even if semantically related.
The astronomer aligns with two bright stars after damage to the finder scope and records position instead of photographs.
The greenhouse key is inside a clay frog at the west gate and volunteers can use it only from sunrise to noon. Access token is a paraphrase for this physical key.
The coat pocket is reinforced with striped cotton and the visible repair deliberately demonstrates reuse.
The ecologist counts bats at dusk with a hand clicker instead of a lit phone to avoid disturbance.
The cafe provides a blue chair for a delayed-bus passenger without requiring purchase and disallows advance booking.

The last lavender honey jar is a gift for the retired gardener and excluded from the market. Named personal recipient is interpreted as a specifically designated recipient by role; the source supplies no proper personal name.

The swimming teacher demonstrates a river crossing on dry ground and children rehearse knots before approaching water. The source supports teacher-led preparation; it does not explicitly record a subsequent supervised in-water exercise.
The clockmaker reduces chime volume using felt on the hammer while keeping timing and hourly schedule unchanged.
The bookseller accepts anonymous walking maps in a shelf gap while prohibiting routes on private paths.
The cheesemaker uses a cellar during power failure, logs temperature hourly, and withholds sales pending safety inspection.
The paper-span experiment varies only fold pattern while paper size, identical copper weights, and load spacing are controlled.
The potter lowers the shelf for children to view unfinished bowls but retains glass and forbids touch.
The French text describes French and Arabic invitations for a neighborhood celebration, with free entry and no preregistration. This independently matches the English query.
The Japanese paragraph describes stargazing on a library rooftop, cancellation in rain, and two telescopes shared in turns. The paragraph is at the end of the long source.

The Spanish text describes a school garden, rainwater buckets, Tuesday watering turns, and no chemical fertilizer. Chemical and synthetic fertilizer are treated as the same requested restriction in this context.
The station volunteer supplies paper timetables when the display fails and stamps each copy with its update time.

The wheelchair-accessible park loop avoids a steep cobbled lane, adds ten minutes, and keeps entrances step-free. Continuous level access is interpreted as the requested accessible route, not a claim that every surface is mathematically flat.

The costume designer hides red thread inside borrowed sleeves to distinguish loans without permanent labels. The query adds seam; the recorded sleeve marker is the unique referent, without asserting a specific seam location.
The sound artist records an empty laundromat before opening and excludes customer conversations or recognizable voices.
The ranger marks the damaged footbridge and delays repair until the river falls below the stone gauge.
The school portrait session permits exposure adjustment but prohibits face retouching and skin-texture changes.
The clinic uses numbered wooden tokens for arrival order and displays no patient names or medical conditions.
The repair cafe notebook records donated component names and quantities while omitting donor addresses. The matching paragraph follows a long repeated prefix.
The cook dries sea salt on ceramic trays and pauses harvesting when the neighboring footpath floods.
The museum guard redirects visitors to the east doorway during floor drying while keeping artworks accessible.
The dance rehearsal omits music to avoid disturbing a neighboring examination and uses a raised hand to start.
The rescue boat requires both charged radios to pass checks before departure and also carries a first-aid pouch.
The seed-envelope return at the library records variety and harvest month and explicitly makes no certified-purity claim.
The movable reed shade screen uses tied joints so it can be dismantled without cutting reeds.
The island walking leaflet gives final ferry time and trails close forty minutes earlier. The relevant paragraph occurs after a long repeated prefix.
The northern observatory ramp is inspected after every freeze and loose boards replaced before evening visitors. Same-title theater Idea 038 does not satisfy this query.
The southern theater brushes velvet cushions on Fridays and prohibits solvent cleaning during rehearsal weeks. Same-title observatory Idea 037 does not satisfy this query.
The query explicitly requests the complete Harbor field collection Document. Only Document 01 is intended; returning a constituent Idea or the whole Project does not fulfill that identity request.
The query explicitly requests only the violin-glue Idea inside Reversible workshop collection. Idea 002 is intended; Document 02 and Project 02 are permitted but are not intended matches.

The tide-clock content exists only in withdrawn, ineligible Idea 040. The permitted harbor Idea and containers do not make withdrawn content eligible; no eligible source fulfills the request.

The nearest library rooftop source explicitly cancels in rain and shares two telescopes in turns. It contradicts both required conditions. Under fulfillment of all stated constraints, there is no match.

The nearest school-garden source uses rainwater, Tuesday turns, and forbids chemical fertilizer. It contradicts chemical fertilizer, daily watering, and tap water. Under fulfillment of all stated constraints, there is no match.
